notice.trustTitle: Your records are not for sale
notice.trustBody: Your entries are private by default. They are processed only for responses you ask for, automatic safety checks, and service audit records.
notice.items: Collected: your email, date of birth, and the entries you write (journals, notes, captures).

detail.title: What you're agreeing to
detail.intro: Plain-language detail for each item you check at sign-up: what it covers, why it is needed, and what your choices are.

service.title: Collection and use to run the service
service.body:
What we collect: your email address, date of birth, and the entries you write (journals, notes, captures).
Why: to run your account, store your entries, draw your growth graph, power your assistant, and confirm you are 14 or older.
How long: while your account is active. You can delete entries or your whole account any time from Settings; deleted data is destroyed without undue delay.
Your choice: you can decline, but this item is essential to provide the service, so sign-up cannot continue without it.

llmProcessing.title: Processing entries for AI responses
llmProcessing.body:
What happens: when you ask for a response, the relevant entries and your request are sent to an AI model (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI).
Only in these cases: responses you ask for, automatic safety checks, and service audit records. Nothing else.
What we never do: sell your entries, use them for ads, or hand them to train outside models.
Your choice: you can decline, but AI responses are core to the service, so sign-up cannot continue without it.

overseasTransfer.title: Processing outside your country
overseasTransfer.body:
Who receives it: Supabase (authentication and database hosting; primary storage in its Seoul region) and, depending on the AI feature, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI.
What is transferred: Supabase stores encrypted account and entry data, which may be processed abroad for support. An AI provider receives only the relevant content needed to create the response you request.
When and how: data is sent over TLS when you use the service; AI content is sent abroad only when you use an AI feature.
How long: Supabase follows account and legal retention periods. AI providers follow the provider-specific limited periods and exceptions described in the Privacy Policy.
Your choice: you can decline, but core processing cannot run without this transfer, so sign-up cannot continue.

sensitiveData.title: How sensitive entries are handled
sensitiveData.body:
What this covers: journals and notes may naturally include sensitive details, such as health or beliefs.
How we handle it: we do not collect or sort it separately; everything stays encrypted, private account data. It is never made public, sold, or used for ads.
Your choice: what you write is entirely up to you, and you can delete any entry at any time.
If you decline: we cannot store your entries without this acknowledgement, so sign-up cannot continue.

safetyNotice.title: How safety routing works
safetyNotice.body:
What this covers: if your writing contains wording that suggests a crisis, 2nd-Brain shows the relevant help lines.
How we handle it: we record THAT the routing happened (the trigger category, the template version, the locale) so we can check the routing still works. We do not store a clinical severity score, and we do not keep the text that triggered it.
What it is not: 2nd-Brain is not an emergency service. It does not call anyone, does not report on your behalf, does not notify a guardian, school, or institution, and does not monitor you. In an emergency, contact the emergency services directly.
Your choice: this is a separate consent under PIPA art.23 because the record is treated as health-related data.
If you decline: sign-up cannot continue, because we would have no basis for the safety record.

marketing.title: Product updates (optional)
marketing.body:
What you get: an occasional email about new features and improvements.
Optional: declining changes nothing about the app.
Withdraw any time: from Settings, or with the unsubscribe link in any email.

detail.footer: Questions? Ask any time from Settings, Support. We reply within 2 business days.

privacy.title: You decide what leaves your account
privacy.subtitle: Sharing, profiling, analytics, and model training all start off.
privacy.speech: Your records stay private unless you turn on a control. Teens stay locked to high-privacy.
privacy.trustBody: Your entries are stored encrypted. Ads never appear unless you turn them on yourself, and even then your entries are never used for ads. 2nd-Brain does not sell your data.
privacy.minorLockNote: You are on a teen account, so high-privacy stays on. Long-term memory is the only switch you can turn on.

ops_push.label: Routine push

sharing.label: Sharing

recommendations.label: Recommendations

persona_share.label: Profile sharing
